annotationMethod: Inspect the complete native sheets and all eight 627-pixel native cell views. Manually select projected pelvic/support X positions from the visible anatomical leg/hip/support structure, excluding pack, canteen and musket. For the four contact cells select cap-crown-only and nearer rear/right supporting-sole-only ROIs. At alpha>=64 recompute cap minY and sole maxYExclusive, yielding body spans [386,348,357,373]. Their median is 365; round half upward to one referenceHeight=365 and apply it unchanged across both complete sources. Ground Y is independently recomputed from each role-appropriate support ROI. Coordinates and ROIs are native cell-local pixels, with exclusive right/bottom ROI edges. No body-box centering, phase scale normalization, casualty height normalization, raster resampling, mirroring, alpha repair, warping or synthesized intermediate pose is approved.
coordinateConvention: Cell-local pixels; row-major order. ROIs [x0,y0,x1,y1] use exclusive right/bottom edges. Ground Y is maxYExclusive of alpha>=64 pixels inside the anatomical support ROI.

groundMethods: X=404 is the manually interpreted projected pelvis center beneath the belt/coat and between the two trouser-leg origins, excluding pack, canteen and rifle. Y is the exclusive alpha>=64 lower edge of the nearer rear/right planted boot sole inside the bounded sole-only ROI; the farther front boot is higher in the oblique projection.

X=391 is the manually interpreted projected pelvis center of the wide leftward level lunge, excluding the backward pack and forward arms. Y is the exclusive alpha>=64 lower edge of the nearer rear/right boot sole; the forward boot and horizontal musket are excluded.

X=417 is the manually interpreted projected pelvis center below the coat in the low recovery, between the two leg origins. Y is the exclusive alpha>=64 lower edge of the nearer rear/right boot sole. The low projecting bayonet does not define the ground or the reference height.

X=389 is the manually interpreted projected pelvis center in the high block. Y is the exclusive alpha>=64 lower edge of the nearer rear/right supporting boot sole; the farther boot and elevated bayonet are excluded.

X=422 is the manually interpreted projected pelvis center of the reeling, bent-knee figure. Y is the exclusive alpha>=64 lower edge of the nearer rear/right boot sole in a sole-only ROI; the lowered rifle and farther boot are excluded.

X=354 marks the interpreted center of support of the lowered nearer knee. Y is the exclusive alpha>=64 lower edge of that blue trouser/knee patch in its bounded ROI; the front boot, rear boot and musket do not determine it.

X=409 marks the interpreted tucked-knee/body support center beneath the forward-falling hip. Y is the exclusive alpha>=64 lower edge of the blue folded trouser support patch immediately to the right of the rifle stock. The ROI excludes the lower weapon and the projecting farther boot.

X=325 marks the interpreted hip/side-body support center in ground rest. Y is the exclusive alpha>=64 lower edge of the nearer thigh/trouser support patch to the right of the rifle butt. The gun extending below and left of the body is excluded. This registers an illustrated support plane, not a measured physical center of mass.

limitations: This is independent model-assisted source inspection, not human art, usability, historical-drill or physical-anatomy certification.

The level lunge still resembles shouldered aim in isolation and its rear grip is partly occluded. The source does not establish exact two-hand thrust mechanics; actual opposing-contact playback must establish useful action readability before installation.

Native stance and joint changes are visible, especially low recovery versus high block, but still frames do not prove temporal smoothness, weight transfer, musket-length continuity or complete hand/finger mechanics.

Projected pelvis/support X positions are manually interpreted illustration registrations, not physical bone, joint or center-of-mass measurements. The oblique support plane does not require every extremity to share one image Y.

Contact cap-to-sole spans range by 38/365, about 10.41 percent, because these are braced/lunging/bent poses. Historical stationary-source 5/6 percent rules are not applied, and natural posture differences are not normalized away.

All casualty poses use the same contact-derived 365-pixel reference. Kneeling and lying height reductions are intentional; relative head/limb/boot and equipment proportions were judged visually, not anatomically certified.

Alpha>=64 silhouette margins are at least 36 pixels in contact and 56 in casualty. Very low-alpha colored noise remains, including some cell-edge pixels. Complete edge/fringe freedom is not certified; source pixels remain unchanged.

The Union A v9 source and Confederate v20 pair were viewed as kit/style/scale references. This does not inherit their source approvals or certify cross-family playback equality; both sides must be compared in the actual renderer at ordinary and close scale.
Inspection-only native cell crops were written outside the candidate without resampling. They are diagnostic views and are not exported or substituted for the complete original PNGs.

Acceptance covers only these two exact source sheets and registrations. Integration, exporter output, complete-action fallback, renderer continuity, pause/cold resume, reduced motion, GPU/ordinary-PC behavior, complete family, default art and local installation require separate checks.
